title: The 1958 Western Trackdown and a wall-building 'Trump'

tellings.quote: and what about this 1958 Western called trackdown in which a man named Trump with Magnetic Charisma and a cult-like Following comes to a town promising to save it by building a wall

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with a guest about the idea that the mind can glimpse the future, brings up Trackdown, a Western on American television in 1958. According to Michels, in one story a man named Trump, with magnetic charisma and a cult-like following, comes to a town promising to save it by building a wall. He offers it as an odd case of a story that seems to foresee later events.
